title: Runtime Boundary Streaming And Deployment Proof Tasks
principles: Implement only accepted findings and keep Channel/Eve-native ownership intact.
Use owner-named Schema, Effect Config, services, Layers, safe tagged errors, flat Effects, and Effect Stream at provider boundaries.
Provider, deployment, dispatch, typing, delivery, and replay claims require separate direct evidence.
Never emit or retain secret values, phone numbers, message bodies, prompts, provider payloads, OAuth material, ciphertext, or chain-of-thought.
Run one terminal five-pass audit only after every predecessor task is complete.
riskLenses: Effect contracts: Schema Type/Encoded provenance, branded identities, Config, named operations, safe tagged errors, flat Effects, Layers, streams, cancellation, and resource lifetime.
Ownership: complete call graphs, app/package boundaries, public exports, helper admission, dead paths, ChatSDK/Eve alignment, and no generic transport or callback capability.

Behavior and proof: clean builds, incremental/fragmented/oversize/failure streaming, replay and idempotency limits, hosted CI, deployment causality, provider readback, rollback, and secret-negative receipts.

tasks.title: Stream and bound Codex SSE incrementally
tasks.description: Carry upstream bytes through Effect Stream, incrementally decode/map bounded SSE lines, enforce the request limit, and return a streaming HTTP response with cancellation propagation.
acceptance: Fragmented text and tool-call events map in order without full-response buffering.
The first mapped chunk is observable before slow upstream completion.
Oversize request/line, upstream failure, and cancellation tests fail safely.
Codex, proxy, and Agent focused checks pass.
mandatoryVerification: Prove fragmented UTF-8/SSE lines and tool-call state map in order and terminate with the correct finish reason and [DONE].
Use a gated slow upstream to prove a first output chunk before upstream completion, then separately prove downstream cancellation reaches the source.
Prove request and residual/complete line overflow fail with safe typed errors and no body leak.
Run Codex and proxy typechecks/tests/build/smoke plus Agent focused checks and repository boundary/Effect gates.
completionCriteria: No full upstream or rewritten response string exists on the live call graph and direct deterministic tests prove the named stream properties.
evidence: The live Codex call graph now carries the upstream body as an Effect byte stream from the private HttpClient response through incremental UTF-8/SSE decoding and OpenAI-compatible mapping to HttpServerResponse.stream; the proof-only postResponses operation remains the sole response.text consumer for its bounded byte/line receipt.

Codex tests directly proved a fragmented multi-byte UTF-8 delta, fragmented tool-call events and ordered state, an early mapped chunk before upstream release, downstream cancellation reaching the source finalizer, safe complete and residual 1 MiB line rejection, and upstream failure without a false completion marker. The Codex suite passed 12 files and 115 tests.

The proxy owns a separate 1 MiB materialised JSON ingress ceiling, with owner-Schema decoding for Content-Length plus MaxBodySize enforcement for observed bytes. Proxy tests proved both declared and observed overflow, and the real Web handler emitted an early chunk before source completion; all 3 files and 40 tests, typecheck, build, and smoke receipt healthStatus 200, streamStatus 200, streamLines 5 passed.

The direct Agent run rebuilt both Eve Node and Vercel outputs with the documented process-only synthetic Executor fixture and passed 15 files and 79 tests. Repository check, check:boundaries and git diff --check passed.

Full bun run verification passed on the receipt-bearing tree: Effect setup, boundaries, docs, skills, authority, controls, verification policy, HGI-307, 107 tooling tests, type-aware lint, lint fixture, Knip, nine workspace typechecks and all fifteen Turbo test tasks. Codex and proxy were cache misses and passed 115 and 40 tests respectively. No provider, deployment, dispatch, delivery or replay claim is made by this slice.

tasks.title: Push, stage, prove, promote, and read back hosted candidates
tasks.description: Push the verified source without auto-deployment, stage exact proxy/Agent candidates, obtain claim-matched Preview and Production proof, perform bounded channel proof where targets are unambiguous, promote only accepted candidates, and retain sanitized rollback/readback evidence.
acceptance: Hosted CI passes the exact pushed SHA and the push creates no automatic Vercel deployment.
Immutable proxy proof covers health, auth controls, incremental SSE first-byte/completion, source, and no-leak predicates.
Immutable Agent proof covers build/routes and accepted channel behavior; dispatch, typing, handset delivery, and strict replay are reported separately.
Stable aliases resolve to the accepted source and both prior READY rollback deployments remain recorded.
mandatoryVerification: Re-read Personal-scope project/deployment/environment-name/provider inventories and exact rollback candidates before every write.
Push the exact verified source, wait for hosted CI, and compare pre/post Vercel deployment inventory to prove no Git-triggered deployment.

Stage immutable proxy and Agent candidates through target-owned runbooks, prove proxy health/auth/first-byte/completion and Agent build/routes, then run bounded live channels only for unambiguous provider targets.
Promote accepted candidates explicitly; read back source, aliases, status, provider state, and rollback IDs; retain sanitized packets and exact non-claims.
completionCriteria: Every accepted hosted predicate has direct current evidence, all mutations are read back, and stable aliases plus rollback state are unambiguous.
evidence: Pre-stage reconciliation found and corrected one implementation defect before the terminal audit: deploy-promote.md already required the positive BUNDJIL_CHANNEL_HANDOFF_TIMEOUT_MILLISECONDS Production binding, but executable preflight omitted it. The owner now admits only encrypted or sensitive metadata, and its negative fixture rejects a missing binding alongside the existing clean Channel and legacy-binding controls.

Fresh Personal-scope readback identified project prj_Q8wOYPLsFFcGGKHlMf7XYgOxgimN and proved the Production timeout binding absent before the write. Under this task's explicit authority, one reversible non-sensitive Production binding was added with value 15000; immediate metadata readback reported target production and type encrypted, and an in-process equality probe returned present true and valid true without printing the value. Rollback is removal of only that binding followed by metadata readback.

The complete preflight inventory then rejected the proxy's existing plain BUNDJIL_UPSTASH_REDIS_KEY_PREFIX against the canonical encrypted-or-sensitive policy. Fresh readback fixed the exact Personal proxy project and Production target; a process-only pipe preserved the non-empty bounded value while changing only its metadata type to encrypted. Immediate readback reported encrypted and opaque fingerprint 61b39331..., with inverse type conversion as rollback; no key, store credential, profile, ciphertext, provider resource or alias changed.
